items.summary: Financial recommendation: preserve containment and authorize no new spend, billing changes, infrastructure expansion, or monetization claims. Retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only as slot-gated, reportable implementation with no incremental budget; do not admit new site-factory, CRO, or duplicate finance work while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Revenue support is insufficient for ROI or forecast claims: Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21 and reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking ID "other". The $4.92 cannot be assigned to a site; named tracking rows show $0 site-attributed commission. The available 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 AI ledger reports 5,522 calls, 234 errors, and $997.51762695 cost, or approximately $0.1806 per call. Comparing the full-month AI cost with the one-day aggregate commission would imply a provisional -$992.60 before infrastructure or other costs, but that comparison is not a valid contribution margin because the revenue and cost windows and attribution scopes do not match. Contribution margin is not calculable: direct infrastructure, hosting, registrar, labor, payment, affiliate, and other variable costs are absent. AI-only contribution after the reported aggregate revenue is likewise not a site or period margin. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because AI spend, implementation effort, exposures, outcomes, and attributable revenue are not linked by work item or experiment. Infrastructure spend and budget exposure are not calculable because no billing ledger, invoices, approved monthly spend limit, fixed-cost baseline, or marketing budget is present; the brief leaves monthly spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor blank. Minimum measurement needed is one read-only dated cost ledger joining AI usage, infrastructure/hosting/registrar invoices, and implementation effort to site or shared-fleet identifiers and work-item IDs, plus a revenue ledger with matching periods, tracking IDs, ordered/shipped status, commission, and direct-cost allocation. Until that exists, treat $4.92 as aggregate cash revenue evidence only, $997.52 as AI operating-cost evidence only, and all site-level revenue, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, ROI, forecasts, and payback claims as unsupported. Preserve the existing report-only CFO reconciliation artifact if present; do not request duplicate telemetry.

The queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement remains financially acceptable only as a bounded, reversible, no-new-spend test after capacity clears. Use the existing baseline of 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Measure changed-page outbound clicks for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks, preserve the registered tracking ID, and report revenue as unknown unless a matched site-attributed commission row appears. Do not generalize any click lift into revenue, contribution margin, ROI, or forecasted earnings.
